recent.reason: LSI, Inc. Recalls BBQ Pork Jerky Product  Due To Possible Foreign Matter Contamination. LSI, Inc., an Alpena, S.D. establishment, is recalling approximately 2,277,540 pounds of a ready-to-eat Korean barbecue pork jerky product that may be contaminated with pieces of metal, the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) announced today.
